data.title: Binghatti Haven
data.about:
Binghatti Haven at Dubai Sports City is an exquisite residential development by Binghatti Developers, offering 501 studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Each residence is thoughtfully designed, blending luxury with functionality, perfect for both families and professionals. The project, featuring 26 residential floors, is strategically located near Motor City, Dubai Hills, and City Centre Meaisem, ensuring easy access to key destinations.

Haven by Binghatti boasts a striking architectural design with sleek lines and modern interiors. Residents enjoy premium amenities such as basketball courts, a green maze, kids' aqua pool, and a smart home system. The development features spacious living areas with expansive windows, offering stunning views of Dubai Sports City.

Binghatti Haven’s prime location provides direct access to major road networks and public transport, making it a highly desirable place to live. Investing in Binghatti Haven offers both comfort and luxury, with a promise of strong long-term value. With its superior design and strategic position, Haven is a true symbol of modern living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Binghatti Haven at Dubai Sports City is situated in a highly sought-after area, offering easy access to major locations like Motor City, Dubai Hills, and City Centre Meaisem.
  • Sports-Centric Community: Located within Dubai Sports City, residents benefit from a dynamic environment, with world-class sports facilities and recreational options.
  • Luxurious Design: The development features a striking architectural façade and modern interiors, blending luxury with functionality.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: Residents can enjoy a wide range of premium amenities, including a basketball court, kids' aqua pool, adult pool, jogging tracks, and a green maze.
  • Spacious Floor Plans: With thoughtfully designed studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Binghatti Haven offers a variety of layouts to suit different lifestyle needs.
  • Strategic Connectivity: Easy access to major road networks and public transport ensures convenience for commuting around Dubai and beyond.
  • Future Growth Potential: Dubai Sports City is a growing district, with increasing demand for residential properties, offering long-term investment potential.

location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Haven at Dubai Sports City is ideally located in one of Dubai’s most vibrant and dynamic districts. Known for its sports-centric community, Dubai Sports City offers a range of world-class amenities, including sports facilities, entertainment venues, and easy access to major roads. This strategic location provides residents with a perfect balance of tranquility and excitement, with close proximity to Motor City, Dubai Hills, and City Centre Meaisem. Investing in Binghatti Haven offers the advantages of a prime location, combining convenience, luxury, and a thriving community.

  • 3 Minutes to City Center Me’aisem
  • 4 Minutes to Dubai International Cricket Stadium
  • 5 Minutes to Dubai Els Club
  • 5 Minutes to Dubai Autodrome
  • 9 Minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
  • 22 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Experience luxury living at Binghatti Haven with spacious studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments featuring stunning views and high-end finishes.

more_info.answer:
Binghatti Haven offers a diverse range of residential units to cater to various needs:

- Studio apartments (117 units) starting from 300 sq. ft.
- 1-bedroom apartments (154 units) starting from 585 sq. ft.
- 2-bedroom apartments (217 units) starting from 903 sq. ft.
- 3-bedroom apartments (13 units) starting from 1,218 sq. ft.

Each unit is thoughtfully designed, blending luxury with functionality to provide a comfortable living space with expansive views of Dubai Sports City.
more_info.question: What types of residential units are available at Binghatti Haven?

more_info.answer:
Binghatti Haven offers a wide range of premium amenities, ensuring a comfortable and vibrant lifestyle for its residents:

- Paddle court for sports enthusiasts
- Kids aqua pool and adult pool for relaxation and recreation
- Jogging tracks for fitness
- A green maze for a peaceful retreat
- Basketball court for outdoor activities
- Smart home system for modern living convenience

These amenities combine to create a holistic living experience for all residents.
more_info.question: What are the key amenities at Binghatti Haven?

more_info.answer:
Binghatti Haven is strategically located in the vibrant and fast-growing Dubai Sports City. The development is close to major landmarks, ensuring both convenience and accessibility:

- 10 minutes to Jumeirah Village Circle
- 7 minutes to Circle Mall, JVC
- 16 minutes to Dubai Investment Park
- 18 minutes to Palm Jumeirah
- 25 minutes to Burj Khalifa
- 27 minutes to Dubai International Airport

Its proximity to major road networks, including Motor City, Dubai Hills, and City Centre Meaisem, makes it an ideal location for residents who value connectivity and convenience.

Investing in Binghatti Haven offers numerous advantages, including:

- Strong rental demand due to its prime location and proximity to key areas
- High-quality residential development, offering modern designs and premium finishes
- Strategic location in Dubai Sports City, a thriving district with continued growth
- Excellent long-term value appreciation, driven by ongoing infrastructure projects and development in the area
- Attractive pricing and flexible payment plans to suit investors' needs

Binghatti Haven promises a comfortable living experience and a strong return on investment, making it appealing to both homeowners and investors.
